tools.name: archive_round
tools.purpose: Persist one independent review as an archive round, stamped with the policy version and hash in force.

tools.name: merge_archive_rounds
tools.purpose: Rebuild the standing per-PR archive branch from the default branch without conflicts.

tools.name: detect_recurring_pattern
tools.purpose: Count recurrence per topic under the policy and recommend target vs mechanism fixes.

tools.name: mine_trace_failures
tools.purpose: Mine failed tool calls from working sessions (local folder or dedicated Traces namespace) into a field-evidence snapshot; scrubs credentials; never prints excerpts in CI.

tools.name: measure_policy_validity
tools.purpose: Coverage of archived findings and Spearman validity of the policy's signal against the field anchor, per round.

tools.name: revise_improvement_policy
tools.purpose: Apply the fixed acceptance rule: propose a bounded revision, a rollback, or nothing.

tools.name: render_rsi_dashboard
tools.purpose: Render the loop's state as a single HTML page.

tools.name: distill_skills
tools.purpose: Turn resolved archive rounds into per-topic playbooks the next fix can load.

tools.name: improvement_policy
tools.purpose: Shared library: policy load/validate/hash, lineage checks, write guards, credential scrubbing, round identity.
